qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Exclusive state-granted franchise territories across Ohio, Pennsylvania, West Virginia, Maryland, and New Jersey. Natural monopoly in electric transmission and distribution with formulaic cost-plus rate-base pricing power, though authorized ROE (~9.5-10%) and returns are strictly capped by state utility commissions.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance Sheet & Cash Conversion, REJECT). Regulated electric transmission and distribution monopoly serving 6 million customers across 5 states. While reformed post-HB6 governance stabilizes operations, massive ongoing grid capex ($4.7B vs $3.7B OCF in FY2025) produces negative free cash flow and maintains an overleveraged balance sheet ($25.5B long-term debt vs $1.02B net income, 25.0x leverage) with precarious 1.81x interest coverage, requiring perpetual reliance on debt and equity capital markets.
qualitative.evidence: FY2025 revenue of $15.09B, EBIT of $2,206M, and net income of $1,020M. 10-year median GAAP ROIC is 4.97%, constrained by regulatory rate caps. Balance sheet carries $25.5B long-term debt against only $57M in cash, resulting in 25.0x debt/NI and 1.81x interest coverage (EBIT $2,206M / Interest $1,217M), failing the >5.0x peace-of-mind threshold. FY2025 capex of $4,705M outpaced OCF of $3,700M by $1.0B.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
